issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.arduino.cc/en/software/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.arduino.cc%2Fen%2Fsoftware%2F) ### Comment > Affected application: Arduino IDE 2.3.10 > > Environment: > > OS: Windows > AdGuard for Windows with SocketFilter / network filtering enabled > Filtering mode: system-wide (traffic routed through AdGuard) > > Summary: > When AdGuard for Windows is running with the SocketFilter active, Arduino IDE 2.3.10 hangs indefinitely on its splash/loading screen and never finishes starting. The IDE works normally as soon as AdGuard is stopped, or when its traffic is excluded from AdGuard's filtering. > > Steps to reproduce: > > Have AdGuard for Windows running with SocketFilter / filtering enabled. > Start Arduino IDE 2.3.10. > Observe that the IDE stays on the splash screen and does not load. > > Expected behavior: > Arduino IDE starts normally; its internal services are reachable via localhost. > > Actual behavior: > The IDE hangs on the splash screen. Reinstalling the IDE and resetting its configuration folders (.arduinoIDE15, Arduino15) does not help. Stopping AdGuard — or excluding the IDE / its localhost traffic from filtering — lets the IDE start immediately. > > Root cause (observed in AdGuard log): > Arduino IDE 2.x communicates between its frontend and internal backend services entirely over loopback (localhost). The AdGuard filtering log shows these local connections being intercepted and filtered: > > http://localhost:65153/cc.arduino.cli.commands.v1.ArduinoCoreService/Create > http://localhost:65153/cc.arduino.cli.commands.v1.ArduinoCoreService/Init > numerous http://localhost:65152/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=polling&... requests > ws://localhost:65152/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=websocket&... > > Several of these requests are marked "7 rules applied" / "Privacy", which indicates AdGuard is actively acting on the IDE's loopback traffic. Because the IDE waits for these local service responses during startup, the interference causes it to hang before the UI loads. > > Workaround (confirmed working): > > Stopping AdGuard, or > Excluding Arduino IDE from AdGuard filtering, or > Not routing the IDE's traffic through AdGuard. ### Screenshots

Stopping AdGuard — or excluding the IDE / its localhost traffic from filtering — lets the IDE start immediately. > > Root cause (observed in AdGuard log): > Arduino IDE 2.x communicates between its frontend and internal backend services entirely over loopback (localhost). ### Issue URL (Anti Adblock Script) [https://e.mail.ru/messages/inbox/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fe.mail.ru%2Fmessages%2Finbox%2F) ### Comment > При новом входе mail.ru блокирует доступ к некоторым ресурсам mail.ru. Если в браузере выключить расширение и выполнить первый вход на проблемный ресурс, то все последующие входы пройдут успешно с включённым блокировщиком. Если отключить фильтрацию на этой странице, то mail.ru всё равно будет блокировать доступ. Я предполагаю, что проблема в каком-то кэшируемом домене, так как все последующие входы с блокировщиком проходят без проблем. # Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

I tested Baidu search again today with the exact same setup (logged in + ad blocking enabled), and the infinite spinning / flickering loading issue **no longer occurs**. The pages now load and work completely normally.

Since the issue cannot be reproduced anymore, I am currently unable to isolate which specific filter or rule caused it. It's likely that Baidu rolled back/updated their front-end scripts, or the filters were updated in the background.

I will keep an eye on this. If it happens again, I will inspect the filtering log to pinpoint the exact rule. Feel free to close this issue for now or keep it open for further observation.

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.arduino.cc/en/software/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.arduino.cc%2Fen%2Fsoftware%2F) ### Comment > Affected application: Arduino IDE 2.3.10 > > Environment: > > OS: Windows > AdGuard for Windows with SocketFilter / network filtering enabled > Filtering mode: system-wide (traffic routed through AdGuard) > > Summary: > When AdGuard for Windows is running with the SocketFilter active, Arduino IDE 2.3.10 hangs indefinitely on its splash/loading screen and never finishes starting. The IDE works normally as soon as AdGuard is stopped, or when its traffic is excluded from AdGuard's filtering. > > Steps to reproduce: > > Have AdGuard for Windows running with SocketFilter / filtering enabled. > Start Arduino IDE 2.3.10. > Observe that the IDE stays on the splash screen and does not load. > > Expected behavior: > Arduino IDE starts normally; its internal services are reachable via localhost. > > Actual behavior: > The IDE hangs on the splash screen. Reinstalling the IDE and resetting its configuration folders (.arduinoIDE15, Arduino15) does not help. Stopping AdGuard — or excluding the IDE / its localhost traffic from filtering — lets the IDE start immediately. > > Root cause (observed in AdGuard log): > Arduino IDE 2.x communicates between its frontend and internal backend services entirely over loopback (localhost). The AdGuard filtering log shows these local connections being intercepted and filtered: > > http://localhost:65153/cc.arduino.cli.commands.v1.ArduinoCoreService/Create > http://localhost:65153/cc.arduino.cli.commands.v1.ArduinoCoreService/Init > numerous http://localhost:65152/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=polling&... requests > ws://localhost:65152/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=websocket&... > > Several of these requests are marked "7 rules applied" / "Privacy", which indicates AdGuard is actively acting on the IDE's loopback traffic. Because the IDE waits for these local service responses during startup, the interference causes it to hang before the UI loads. > > Workaround (confirmed working): > > Stopping AdGuard, or > Excluding Arduino IDE from AdGuard filtering, or > Not routing the IDE's traffic through AdGuard. ### Screenshots

Если в браузере выключить расширение и выполнить первый вход на проблемный ресурс, то все последующие входы пройдут успешно с включённым блокировщиком. Если отключить фильтрацию на этой странице, то mail.ru всё равно будет блокировать доступ. ### Issue URL (Anti Adblock Script) [https://e.mail.ru/messages/inbox/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fe.mail.ru%2Fmessages%2Finbox%2F) ### Comment > При новом входе mail.ru блокирует доступ к некоторым ресурсам mail.ru. Если в браузере выключить расширение и выполнить первый вход на проблемный ресурс, то все последующие входы пройдут успешно с включённым блокировщиком. Если отключить фильтрацию на этой странице, то mail.ru всё равно будет блокировать доступ. Я предполагаю, что проблема в каком-то кэшируемом домене, так как все последующие входы с блокировщиком проходят без проблем. Сама проблема очень напряжённая, так как это касается не одного ресурса в mail.ru и это требует полного отключения расширения. ``` Username: @okSashaok ``` ### Screenshots

Quando abro um e-mail ou o marco como não lido e tento fechar ou atualizar a página, surge um aviso de que 'as alterações podem não ser salvas'. O pior é que as alterações realmente não são salvas e tudo é desfeito. No entanto, se eu desativar o AdGuard, o Gmail funciona perfeitamente: posso ler e marcar e-mails sem que a caixa de diálogo apareça e sem perder nenhuma alteração. > > EN: I'm experiencing an issue while using Gmail with AdGuard enabled. When I open an email or mark one as unread and try to close or refresh the page, a warning pops up stating that "changes may not be saved." To make matters worse, the changes actually aren't saved and everything is undone. However, if I disable AdGuard, Gmail works perfectly: I can read and mark emails without the dialog box appearing and without losing any changes. ### Screenshots

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

comment.body:
Not reproduced AdGuard filters on my end.

Please try following actions, then check the problem again:
1. Leave only AdGuard filters
2. Disable all content blockers in Safari settings and enable them again
3. Restart Safari
4. Restart AdGuard
5. Check for filters update in AdGuard.
### Important:
<!-- **AdGuard for iOS** -->
* Do not close AdGuard window ~60 seconds, because iOS will break configuration process.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Ads) [NSFW] [https://www.deviantart.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.deviantart.com%2F) ### Comment > Не блокируется самореклама (премиум аккаунта) на deviantart.com, тестировал в браузерах Opera, Firefox, SRWare Iron. Реклама регулярно всплывает при посещении как главной страницы, так и страниц пользователей, а также при добавлении\закачки собственных картин на девиантарт. > > Её можно увидеть только залогированым в deviantart аккаунт пользователям. > > С использованием пользовательского фильтра баннер блокируется некорректно -- сам банер исчезает, но левая кнопка мышка блокируется. > При попытке блокировать через Adguard Assistant, мышка не фокусируется на окне adguard (баннер блокирует ЛКМ). > > За банер отвечает тэг <dialog> c классом .elL4B0, обёрнутый в <div> c классом .ZaFWss. На текущий момент классы постоянные, не меняются при переходе страниц и перезгрузке. > При удалении всего элемента <dialog> через html инспектор -- всё работает корректно. > > Пользовательский фильтр: > www.deviantart.com##.ZaFWss > www.deviantart.com##.elL4B0 > ### [NSFW] Screenshots [Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/ft9hlhmruvk8wc4k0go8o8gsog4gco88atr9opmggk.jpg?nc=1) [Screenshot 2](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/g6wbi9qplrwcsc4kws8kw48ww808wwccvkvh6qidgg.jpg?nc=1) [Screenshot 3](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/jmnj9qunxoo4owg04g0o4sskswg4oocraqbklvf4is.jpg?nc=1) ### System configuration | Information | Value | |-------------|-------| AdGuard product: | AdGuard for Windows v8.0.0 (5560) System version: | `Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.19045.0` Browser: | Opera License type: | paid AdGuard driver: | WFP Filters: | **Ad Blocking:**
